notes: Tuition: no page gives a fixed fee for non-EU students, a country-group fee naming Morocco, or an income-based fee for this student for 2026/27; the only quantified figure is the general university range of the total annual tuition, so it was not included. The Avviso Aggiuntivo 2026/27 says the yearly 'contributo omnicomprensivo' for degree courses can vary from 0,00 to 2000,00 euro, and the istitutional page states 'L'ammontare totale delle tasse può variare da un minimo di 16,00 ad un massimo di 2.176,00 euro', but this includes the regional tax (tassa regionale per il diritto allo studio) and the stamp duty (imposta di bollo), which the task says are not tuition. Application: the pre-enrolment (preiscrizione) on Universitaly for non-EU applicants residing abroad closes on 30 June 2026; before that, a pre-evaluation application must be submitted on the Elix-Forms platform between 01/02/2026 and 31/05/2026. The admission for this programme is local and capped at 100 places, of which 30 are reserved for non-EU students residing abroad.
